title: How early should you arrive at Southampton Airport?
author: Matt
cover_image_alt: A twin-propeller passenger plane coming in to land against a pale blue sky
intro: Southampton is one of the UK's quickest airports to get through, with a railway station next to the terminal and short security queues. Here's how early to arrive for a domestic hop, a Channel Islands flight or a summer holiday.
seo_title: Southampton Airport: arrive 1½ to 2 hours before? (2026)
seo_description: About 1 to 1½ hours before a UK or Channel Islands flight from Southampton, and 2 hours before a flight to Europe. Times, security and trains.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **UK and Channel Islands:** about 1 to 1½ hours
- **European flights:** about 2 hours
- **Checking a bag:** add 30 mins
- **Station to terminal:** about a 3-min walk

These are our suggestions, not airport rules. Southampton asks passengers to allow enough time for check-in, security and the shops, and the deadlines that really matter are your airline's check-in and boarding times, which are in your booking. Rules and routes change, so check with the airport or your airline before you fly. We checked the details below in November 2026.

sections.heading: Why Southampton is quick
sections.text:
Southampton is a small regional airport with one compact terminal. Most of its flights are short hops on propeller planes, to the Channel Islands and UK cities such as Manchester, with fewer passengers on each flight than a big holiday jet.

That means short queues on most days. The busy times are the early morning departures, Friday and Sunday evenings, and the summer holidays, when the airport adds sun routes. It expected its busiest summer yet in 2026, so allow a bit more time in July and August.

sections.heading: How early for your flight
sections.text:
| Flight | Example routes | Our suggestion |
| --- | --- | --- |
| UK, hand luggage only | Manchester and other UK cities | 1 hour |
| Channel Islands | Jersey, Guernsey | 1 to 1½ hours |
| UK or Channel Islands with a bag | Any of the above | 1½ hours |
| Europe | Paris, Amsterdam, summer sun routes | 2 hours |

On domestic flights you won't go through passport control, so you can cut it finer. On European flights you'll need your passport checked at the gate, and some airlines close bag drop 40 to 60 minutes before departure.

Tip: on the small propeller planes, larger cabin bags are often taken from you at the aircraft steps and returned on arrival. Pack valuables, medicines and chargers in a small bag you keep with you.

sections.heading: Security and liquids
sections.text:
Southampton finished installing new CT security scanners in 2025. Laptops, tablets and liquids can stay in your bag, and liquids no longer need a separate plastic bag. But each container must still be **100ml or less**: Southampton hasn't moved to the 2-litre limit that a few bigger airports have.

Watch out: the airport you fly home from may not have the new scanners. Pack liquids so you can take them out in a clear bag if you need to, and keep larger bottles in a hold bag.

sections.heading: Getting to Southampton Airport
sections.text:
This is where Southampton really stands out:

- **By train:** Southampton Airport Parkway station is right next to the terminal, about a three-minute walk. It's on the main line between London Waterloo and Southampton Central, with fast trains from London taking a little over an hour, and services from Winchester, Basingstoke and Bournemouth.
- **By car:** the airport is just off the M27, close to junction 5. Short and long stay car parks are a short walk from the terminal, and booking ahead is usually cheaper.
- **Dropping off:** there's a drop-off area by the terminal, which usually has a charge, so check the current price on the airport's website.

Because the walk from train to terminal is so short, many people time their train to arrive about an hour before a domestic flight. Check the timetable for early starts, as the first trains of the day may not fit a dawn departure.

sections.heading: Which airlines fly from Southampton?
sections.text:
Southampton's routes change more than most, so check the airport's website for the current list. When we checked:

- **Loganair** flies to UK cities and the Channel Islands, though it announced it would stop basing aircraft at Southampton from late October 2026, so check which routes continue.
- **Aurigny** connects Southampton with Guernsey.
- **easyJet** has added its first Southampton route this winter, to Paris Charles de Gaulle twice a week.
- **Summer sun routes** in 2026 included Palma, Alicante and Faro.

If you can't find a direct flight, [Bristol](/blog/where-can-you-fly-direct-from-bristol-airport) and [Gatwick](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-gatwick-airport) have far more routes.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Southampton?
sections.text:
Southampton's short flights suit long weekends:

- **A city break:** [Paris](/destinations/paris) with easyJet this winter, or [Amsterdam](/destinations/amsterdam)
- **Summer sun:** [Mallorca](/destinations/mallorca), the [Algarve](/destinations/algarve) or the Costa Blanca around [Altea](/destinations/altea)

The [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) and [beach holidays](/destinations/beach-holidays) pages have more ideas. If you can't agree where to go, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday), or put your shortlist into a draw on somewhere.party.

faqs.question: How early should I get to Southampton Airport?
faqs.answer: About 1 to 1½ hours before a UK or Channel Islands flight, and about 2 hours before a flight to Europe. Add 30 minutes if you're dropping a bag at a busy time.

faqs.question: Is there a train station at Southampton Airport?
faqs.answer: Yes. Southampton Airport Parkway is next to the terminal, about a three-minute walk, with direct trains from London Waterloo, Winchester and Southampton Central.

faqs.question: What is the liquids limit at Southampton Airport?
faqs.answer: 100ml per container. Southampton has new scanners, so liquids can stay in your bag without a plastic bag, but it hasn't moved to the 2-litre limit.

faqs.question: Is Southampton Airport busy?
faqs.answer: Usually not. Queues are short on most days, but early mornings, Friday and Sunday evenings and the summer holidays are busier.
